steps.title: Pellet 1–5 ml bacterial overnight culture...
steps.instruction: Pellet 1–5 ml bacterial overnight culture by centrifugation at >8000 rpm (6800 x g) for 3 min at room temperature (15–25°C).

steps.title: Resuspend pelleted bacterial cells in 250...
steps.instruction: Resuspend pelleted bacterial cells in 250 μl Buffer P1 and transfer to a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add 250 μl Buffer P2 and...
steps.instruction: Add 250 μl Buffer P2 and mix thoroughly by inverting the tube 4–6 times until the solution becomes clear. Do not allow the lysis reaction to proceed for more than 5 min. If using LyseBlue reagent, the solution will turn blue.

steps.title: Add 350 μl Buffer N3 and...
steps.instruction: Add 350 μl Buffer N3 and mix immediately and thoroughly by inverting the tube 4–6 times. If using LyseBlue reagent, the solution will turn colorless.

steps.title: Centrifuge for 10 min at 13,000...
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 min at 13,000 rpm (~17,900 x g) in a table-top microcentrifuge.
